name: PT Remala Abadi Tbk
summary: PT Remala Abadi Tbk operates as an internet service provider in Indonesia. The company provides broadband internet, local link services, and server colocation services; connectivity/installation and multimedia services; and managed services for IP CAM setup, VOIP, and WiFi device. It also offers cloud services, virtual private networks, IoT, CCTV, IP domain, IP public, email solutions, etc. In addition, the company engages in wholesale trading; information and communication; construction of magnetic and optical media; telecommunication with cable activities; and computer programming activities.
